lines: Look, look!! There's nowhere left to run!!
She may have been a young Sakura-sensei, but her ability was still overwhelming. She chased me with her two swords, and in the blink of an eye she had me cornered.
(Behind me is the water's edge... what should I do!?)
Black blades sprang out from Sakura-sensei's shadow and attacked me all at once.
Rinko-san!? What is it? Do you want to finish him?
No, it's a misunderstanding! That guy is not an intruder, he's... um...
My little brother! Yes, he's my little brother!!
Rinko's words left Sakura-sensei frozen with a surprised look on her face.
Sakura-sensei stared at my face intently.
You're right! You guys look so alike!!!
We couldn't help but raise our voices.
Ah, I-I mean... people say that all the time... right, R-Rinko-senp... nee-chan...
Y-Yeah... I can't believe i-, er... I'm as happy as can be, little brother.
We were rambling desperately to smooth things over. Rinko-senpai had covered for me, so we couldn't afford to make Sakura-sensei suspicious again...
Oh my gooosh, you should've told me earlier! C'mon!
Sakura-sensei was slapping my back energetically.
(Th-Thank god... that Sakura-sensei is naive, now and in the past...)
I was deeply relieved, but at that momentー
The scenery around us changed completely and we were caught in something like a huge vortex.
Here he comes! The intruder, be careful!!
Are you okay, Fu... little brother?! Ugh... what the hell is going on?!
